text.en:
1. (1) The following persons shall be disqualified for being appointed or
being members of the Council—

(a) a person who is of unsound mitid of is otherwise incapable of
performing his: duties;
(b) a bankrupt;

(c) a person who has been convicted of an offence involving fraud,
dishonesty or moral turpitude.

(2) A member shall, unless he sooner resigns or his appointment
revoked, hold office for such term (not exceeding three years) as may be
specified in the instrument appointing him, and shall be eligible for
re-appointment.

(3) A member of the Council shall vacate his office if he fails to
attend three consécutive meetings of the Council without the permission
in writing of the Chairman of if he becomes disqualified under sub-
paragraph (1).

(4) The Minister may authorise the payment out of the Fund of such
allowances to the members of the Council as the Minister may determine.

2. The Council shall meet at least once in the first and third quarter of
each year for the purpose of considering its activities during the half year
ending on the 31st day of December and 30th day of June, as the case
may be, immediately preceding such quarter.

3. (1) The quorum of the Council shall be seven.

(2) If on any question to be determined by the Council there is an
equality of votes, the Chairman or other member acting as Chairman
shall have a casting vote.

(3) Subject to sub-paragraphs (1) and (2) the Council shall determine
its own procedure.

(4) The seal of the College shall be authenticated by the Chairman
of the Council or other member acting as Chairman, and one other
member of the Council, and any document purporting to be sealed with
the said seal, authenticated as aforesaid, shall until the contrary is shown
be deemed to have been validly executed.

4. (1) The Deputy Chairman shall perform the functions of the Chair-
man in the absence of the Chairman.

(2) The Minister may appoint a person to be a temporary Chairman,
Deputy Chairman or member of the Council during the temporary
incapacity from illness, or during the temporary absence from the
Federation, of the Chairman, Deputy Chairman or other member, as the
case may be.

(3) The Principal of the College shall be secretary of the Council
with no voting rights,

5. The Council may appoint any committee other than the committee
mentioned in section 5, as it deems fit; and subject to any directions
by the Council, a committee so appointed shall determine its own
procedure.
